Daily Conversation|Advanced.meaning: Admitting you honestly did not expect the traffic to be this bad so late in the day.
Daily Conversation|Advanced.sentence: بصراحة، لم أتوقع أن يكون الازدحام بهذه الشدة في مثل هذا الوقت المتأخر.

Daily Conversation|Advanced.meaning: Suggesting you both think the matter over carefully before making a decision you might regret.
Daily Conversation|Advanced.sentence: أظن أن الأمر يستحق التفكير مليا قبل أن نتخذ قرارا نندم عليه لاحقا.

Daily Conversation|Advanced.meaning: Advising the person to offer a sincere apology, since the quarrel is not worth all this trouble.
Daily Conversation|Advanced.sentence: لو كنت مكانك لاعتذرت له بصدق، فالخلاف بينكما لا يستحق كل هذا.

Daily Conversation|Advanced.meaning: Saying that circumstances have changed a great deal, yet you remain hopeful about the future.
Daily Conversation|Advanced.sentence: أشعر أن الظروف تغيرت كثيرا، ومع ذلك ما زلت متفائلا بالمستقبل.

Daily Conversation|Advanced.meaning: Wishing you had been told in advance so you could have rearranged things and joined the meeting.
Daily Conversation|Advanced.sentence: كنت أتمنى لو أخبرتني مسبقا حتى أرتب أموري وأحضر معكم الاجتماع.

Daily Conversation|Advanced.meaning: Admitting some hesitation: the offer is tempting, but the responsibility that comes with it is heavy.
Daily Conversation|Advanced.sentence: الحقيقة أنني مترددة قليلا، فالعرض مغر لكن المسؤولية كبيرة جدا.

Daily Conversation|Advanced.meaning: Remarking regretfully that the service at this restaurant has noticeably declined over recent months.
Daily Conversation|Advanced.sentence: من المؤسف أن الخدمة في هذا المطعم تراجعت بشكل ملحوظ خلال الأشهر الماضية.

Daily Conversation|Advanced.meaning: Suggesting their misunderstanding came from poor communication rather than any real disagreement.
Daily Conversation|Advanced.sentence: أعتقد أن سوء الفهم بينهما نشأ من قلة التواصل لا من الخلاف الحقيقي.

Daily Conversation|Advanced.meaning: Speaking frankly to say you disliked the way he spoke in front of the guests yesterday.
Daily Conversation|Advanced.sentence: سأصارحك القول، لم يعجبني أسلوبه في الحديث أمام الضيوف أمس.

Daily Conversation|Advanced.meaning: Observing that the more responsibility you take on at work, the less time you have for friends.
Daily Conversation|Advanced.sentence: كلما ازدادت مسؤولياتي في العمل، قل الوقت الذي أقضيه مع أصدقائي.

Daily Conversation|Advanced.meaning: Asking to be excused for leaving the party early because of an emergency.
Daily Conversation|Advanced.sentence: أرجو أن تعذرني، فقد اضطررت إلى مغادرة الحفل مبكرا بسبب ظرف طارئ.

Daily Conversation|Advanced.meaning: Saying honestly that you would rather postpone this discussion until things calm down a bit.
Daily Conversation|Advanced.sentence: صراحة، أفضل أن نؤجل هذا النقاش إلى أن تهدأ الأمور قليلا.

Daily Conversation|Advanced.meaning: Noting that the person has seemed distracted all morning and asking if something is bothering them.
Daily Conversation|Advanced.sentence: لاحظت أنك شارد الذهن منذ الصباح، هل هناك شيء يضايقك؟

Daily Conversation|Advanced.meaning: Saying that however much you disagree, mutual respect matters more than any argument.
Daily Conversation|Advanced.sentence: مهما اختلفنا في الرأي، يبقى احترامنا لبعضنا أهم من أي نقاش.

Daily Conversation|Advanced.meaning: Worrying that bad weather tomorrow might force everyone to cancel the trip.
Daily Conversation|Advanced.sentence: أخشى أن يكون الطقس سيئا غدا، فيضطر الجميع إلى إلغاء الرحلة.

Daily Conversation|Advanced.meaning: Concluding after long reflection that patience is the best course at this stage.
Daily Conversation|Advanced.sentence: بعد تفكير طويل، اقتنعت أن الصبر في هذه المرحلة أفضل الحلول.

Daily Conversation|Advanced.meaning: Admitting the matter upset you, but saying you chose to stay quiet to protect the relationship.
Daily Conversation|Advanced.sentence: لا أنكر أن الأمر أزعجني، لكنني آثرت الصمت حفاظا على العلاقة.

Daily Conversation|Advanced.meaning: Remarking that prices have gone up lately, and even vegetables have become oddly expensive.
Daily Conversation|Advanced.sentence: يبدو أن الأسعار ارتفعت مؤخرا، حتى الخضروات صارت مكلفة بشكل غريب.

Daily Conversation|Advanced.meaning: Saying how glad you were to meet today and hoping to get together again soon.
Daily Conversation|Advanced.sentence: سررت كثيرا بلقائك اليوم، وأتمنى أن نكرر هذه الجلسة في وقت قريب.

Daily Conversation|Advanced.meaning: Saying you still remember that trip fondly even though many years have passed.
Daily Conversation|Advanced.sentence: ما زلت أتذكر تلك الرحلة رغم مرور سنوات طويلة على ذكرياتها الجميلة.

Daily Conversation|Beginner.meaning: A friendly morning greeting: good morning, my friend, how are you today?
Daily Conversation|Beginner.sentence: صباح الخير، كيف حالك اليوم يا صديقي؟

Daily Conversation|Beginner.meaning: A polite reply to a greeting: I am fine, thank you, and how about you?
Daily Conversation|Beginner.sentence: أنا بخير، شكرا لك، وأنت كيف حالك؟

Daily Conversation|Beginner.meaning: An evening greeting that welcomes a guest into your home.
Daily Conversation|Beginner.sentence: مساء الخير، أهلا وسهلا بك في بيتنا.

Daily Conversation|Beginner.meaning: Politely asking someone for a glass of cold water.
Daily Conversation|Beginner.sentence: من فضلك، أريد كوب ماء بارد.

Daily Conversation|Beginner.meaning: Introducing yourself as a new student at this large school.
Daily Conversation|Beginner.sentence: أنا طالب جديد في هذه المدرسة الكبيرة.

Daily Conversation|Beginner.meaning: Politely asking someone what time it is right now.
Daily Conversation|Beginner.sentence: كم الساعة الآن من فضلك يا أخي؟

Daily Conversation|Beginner.meaning: Asking for directions to the nearest bus station.
Daily Conversation|Beginner.sentence: أين محطة الحافلات القريبة من هنا؟

Daily Conversation|Beginner.meaning: Complimenting the food and thanking the person who served it.
Daily Conversation|Beginner.sentence: هذا الطعام لذيذ جدا، شكرا لك كثيرا.

Daily Conversation|Beginner.meaning: Saying you are a bit hungry and suggesting that you eat now.
Daily Conversation|Beginner.sentence: أنا جائع قليلا، هل نأكل الآن؟

Daily Conversation|Beginner.meaning: Commenting that the weather is hot and that you want something to drink.
Daily Conversation|Beginner.sentence: الجو حار اليوم، أريد أن أشرب شيئا.

Daily Conversation|Beginner.meaning: Saying you did not understand and asking the person to repeat it.
Daily Conversation|Beginner.sentence: عفوا، لم أفهم كلامك، أعد من فضلك.

Daily Conversation|Beginner.meaning: Inviting someone to take the seat next to you.
Daily Conversation|Beginner.sentence: تفضل، اجلس هنا بجانبي من فضلك.

Daily Conversation|Beginner.meaning: Saying goodbye and that you will see the person early tomorrow morning.
Daily Conversation|Beginner.sentence: إلى اللقاء، أراك غدا في الصباح الباكر.

Daily Conversation|Beginner.meaning: Asking a shop assistant how much the blue shirt costs.
Daily Conversation|Beginner.sentence: كم سعر هذا القميص الأزرق من فضلك؟

Daily Conversation|Beginner.meaning: Apologising sincerely for arriving a little late today.
Daily Conversation|Beginner.sentence: أنا آسف جدا، لقد تأخرت قليلا اليوم.

Daily Conversation|Beginner.meaning: Asking whether the person prefers tea or coffee with milk.
Daily Conversation|Beginner.sentence: هل تشرب الشاي أم القهوة مع الحليب؟

Daily Conversation|Beginner.meaning: Describing a small family with one brother and one sister.
Daily Conversation|Beginner.sentence: عائلتي صغيرة، عندي أخ واحد وأخت واحدة.

Daily Conversation|Beginner.meaning: Politely asking a man where the toilet is.
Daily Conversation|Beginner.sentence: أين الحمام من فضلك يا سيدي؟

Daily Conversation|Beginner.meaning: Saying it is a day off and you will stay home with your family.
Daily Conversation|Beginner.sentence: اليوم عطلة، سأبقى في البيت مع أسرتي.

Daily Conversation|Beginner.meaning: Inviting someone to come along because you are heading to the market now.
Daily Conversation|Beginner.sentence: تعال معي، سنذهب إلى السوق الآن.

Daily Conversation|Intermediate.meaning: Apologising for being late and blaming the heavy traffic on the way.
Daily Conversation|Intermediate.sentence: أعتذر عن التأخير، كان الازدحام شديدا في الطريق اليوم.

Daily Conversation|Intermediate.meaning: Politely asking someone for directions to the central station.
Daily Conversation|Intermediate.sentence: هل يمكنك أن تخبرني كيف أصل إلى المحطة المركزية؟

Daily Conversation|Intermediate.meaning: Explaining that you slept badly because the neighbours were talking loudly.
Daily Conversation|Intermediate.sentence: لم أنم جيدا الليلة الماضية لأن الجيران كانوا يتحدثون بصوت عال.

Daily Conversation|Intermediate.meaning: Telling a friend you will drop by after work for coffee and a chat.
Daily Conversation|Intermediate.sentence: سأمر عليك بعد العمل لنشرب القهوة ونتحدث قليلا.

Daily Conversation|Intermediate.meaning: Noting the lovely weather and suggesting a walk in the park.
Daily Conversation|Intermediate.sentence: الطقس اليوم جميل جدا، ما رأيك أن نتمشى في الحديقة؟

Daily Conversation|Intermediate.meaning: Saying you have worked at a small company for about three years and enjoy the job.
Daily Conversation|Intermediate.sentence: أعمل في شركة صغيرة منذ ثلاث سنوات تقريبا وأحب عملي.

Daily Conversation|Intermediate.meaning: Asking a restaurant for a table for two by the window if possible.
Daily Conversation|Intermediate.sentence: من فضلك، أريد طاولة لشخصين قرب النافذة إذا كان ذلك ممكنا.

Daily Conversation|Intermediate.meaning: Explaining you left your phone at home and asking to borrow theirs for a minute.
Daily Conversation|Intermediate.sentence: نسيت هاتفي في البيت، هل يمكنني استخدام هاتفك لدقيقة واحدة؟

Daily Conversation|Intermediate.meaning: Saying you meant to visit yesterday but unfortunately ran out of time.
Daily Conversation|Intermediate.sentence: كنت أنوي زيارتك أمس، لكن الوقت لم يسعفني للأسف.

Daily Conversation|Intermediate.meaning: Asking whether they know a good place nearby that serves traditional local food.
Daily Conversation|Intermediate.sentence: هل تعرف مطعما جيدا في هذه المنطقة يقدم أكلا شعبيا؟

Daily Conversation|Intermediate.meaning: Saying you feel very tired and will probably go to bed early tonight.
Daily Conversation|Intermediate.sentence: أشعر بتعب شديد اليوم، أظن أنني سأنام مبكرا هذه الليلة.

Daily Conversation|Intermediate.meaning: Inviting a guest to sit down and offering to bring them a cold drink shortly.
Daily Conversation|Intermediate.sentence: تفضل بالجلوس، سأحضر لك شيئا باردا تشربه بعد قليل.

Daily Conversation|Intermediate.meaning: Asking someone to call you once they get home so you know they are safe.
Daily Conversation|Intermediate.sentence: اتصل بي عندما تصل إلى البيت حتى أطمئن عليك.

Daily Conversation|Intermediate.meaning: Turning down an evening invitation because you have a lot of work.
Daily Conversation|Intermediate.sentence: لا أستطيع الخروج هذا المساء لأن عندي عملا كثيرا.

Daily Conversation|Intermediate.meaning: Asking for an honest opinion about the shirt you just bought.
Daily Conversation|Intermediate.sentence: أخبرني بصراحة، ما رأيك في هذا القميص الذي اشتريته؟

Daily Conversation|Intermediate.meaning: Saying the price is a bit high and asking the seller for a discount.
Daily Conversation|Intermediate.sentence: سعر هذا غال قليلا، هل يمكن أن تخفض السعر؟

Daily Conversation|Intermediate.meaning: Introducing yourself as new to the neighbourhood and asking where the nearest pharmacy is.
Daily Conversation|Intermediate.sentence: مرحبا، أنا جديد في هذا الحي، أين أقرب صيدلية؟

Daily Conversation|Intermediate.meaning: Explaining that the train was half an hour late, so you arrived late to the meeting.
Daily Conversation|Intermediate.sentence: تأخر القطار نصف ساعة، لذلك وصلت متأخرا إلى الاجتماع.

Daily Conversation|Intermediate.meaning: Saying you like to read a little before bed because it helps you relax.
Daily Conversation|Intermediate.sentence: أحب أن أقرأ قليلا قبل النوم، فهذا يساعدني على الاسترخاء.

Daily Conversation|Intermediate.meaning: Asking whether the market is still open at this hour.
Daily Conversation|Intermediate.sentence: هل تعرف إن كان السوق ما زال مفتوحا في هذا الوقت؟

Read Aloud|Advanced.meaning: Getting pronunciation right calls for close listening and thoughtful repetition of the harder sounds.
Read Aloud|Advanced.sentence: إنَّ إتقانَ النُّطقِ الصَّحيحِ يَتَطَلَّبُ إصغاءً دَقيقًا وَتَكرارًا واعِيًا لِلأصواتِ الصَّعبَةِ.

Read Aloud|Advanced.meaning: The speaker calmly kept laying out his point, backing it up with clear real-life examples.
Read Aloud|Advanced.sentence: ظَلَّ الخَطيبُ يَشرَحُ فِكرَتَهُ بِهُدوءٍ، مُستَشهِدًا بِأمثِلَةٍ واضِحَةٍ مِنَ الواقِعِ.

Read Aloud|Advanced.meaning: Under heavy pressure, the team still managed to finish the job on time.
Read Aloud|Advanced.sentence: رَغمَ الضَّغطِ الشَّديدِ، استَطاعَ الفَريقُ أن يُنجِزَ المُهِمَّةَ في مَوعِدِها المُحَدَّدِ.

Read Aloud|Advanced.meaning: Patience proves its worth exactly when things get complicated and the results you hoped for are slow to come.
Read Aloud|Advanced.sentence: تَتَجَلّى قِيمَةُ الصَّبرِ حينَ تَتَعَقَّدُ الظُّروفُ وَتَتَأخَّرُ النَّتائِجُ المُنتَظَرَةُ.

Read Aloud|Advanced.meaning: Experts warned against leaning entirely on quick fixes without studying the matter in depth.
Read Aloud|Advanced.sentence: حَذَّرَ الخُبَراءُ مِنَ الاعتِمادِ المُطلَقِ عَلى الحُلولِ السَّريعَةِ دونَ دِراسَةٍ مُعَمَّقَةٍ.

Read Aloud|Advanced.meaning: The decision was a hard one, but the emergency situation left no other option.
Read Aloud|Advanced.sentence: لَم يَكُنِ القَرارُ سَهلًا، غَيرَ أنَّ الظُّروفَ الطّارِئَةَ فَرَضَت هَذا الاختِيارَ.

Read Aloud|Advanced.meaning: The new discovery set off a wide debate among researchers at universities everywhere.
Read Aloud|Advanced.sentence: أثارَ الاكتِشافُ الجَديدُ نِقاشًا واسِعًا بَينَ الباحِثينَ في مُختَلَفِ الجامِعاتِ.

Read Aloud|Advanced.meaning: A skilled translator is careful to carry over the spirit of a text, not merely its literal words.
Read Aloud|Advanced.sentence: يَحرِصُ المُتَرجِمُ الماهِرُ عَلى نَقلِ الرّوحِ لا الحُروفِ وَحدَها.

Read Aloud|Advanced.meaning: The city has gone through striking building and development changes over the past decade.
Read Aloud|Advanced.sentence: شَهِدَتِ المَدينَةُ تَحَوُّلًا عُمرانِيًّا مَلحوظًا خِلالَ السَّنَواتِ العَشرِ الماضِيَةِ.

Read Aloud|Advanced.meaning: The more a person learns, the more they realise just how much they still do not know.
Read Aloud|Advanced.sentence: كُلَّما ازدادَ الإنسانُ عِلمًا، ازدادَ إدراكًا لِاتِّساعِ ما يَجهَلُهُ.

Read Aloud|Advanced.meaning: The throat sounds in Arabic need special drilling and a relaxed throat to produce properly.
Read Aloud|Advanced.sentence: تَحتاجُ الأصواتُ الحَلقِيَّةُ في العَرَبِيَّةِ إلى تَدريبٍ خاصٍّ وَاسترخاءٍ في الحَنجَرَةِ.

Read Aloud|Advanced.meaning: The committee advised taking another look at the plan before signing off on it for good.
Read Aloud|Advanced.sentence: أوصَتِ اللَّجنَةُ بِإعادَةِ النَّظَرِ في الخُطَّةِ قَبلَ اعتِمادِها بِصورَةٍ نِهائِيَّةٍ.

Read Aloud|Advanced.meaning: What caught the reader in the novel was its precise portrayal of the hero's conflicting feelings.
Read Aloud|Advanced.sentence: استَوقَفَني في الرِّوايَةِ ذَلِكَ الوَصفُ الدَّقيقُ لِمَشاعِرِ البَطَلِ المُتَناقِضَةِ.

Read Aloud|Advanced.meaning: Economic progress cannot be pulled apart from serious investment in education.
Read Aloud|Advanced.sentence: لا يُمكِنُ فَصلُ التَّقَدُّمِ الاقتِصادِيِّ عَنِ الاستِثمارِ الجادِّ في التَّعليمِ.

Read Aloud|Advanced.meaning: The hall burst into applause as the organisers read out the winners' names.
Read Aloud|Advanced.sentence: ضَجَّتِ القاعَةُ بِالتَّصفيقِ حينَ أعلَنَ المُنَظِّمونَ أسماءَ الفائِزينَ.

Read Aloud|Advanced.meaning: Some people assume fluency means speaking fast, when it really means being clear and well organised.
Read Aloud|Advanced.sentence: يَظُنُّ البَعضُ أنَّ الطَّلاقَةَ سُرعَةٌ، وَالحَقيقَةُ أنَّها وُضوحٌ وَتَرتيبٌ.

Read Aloud|Advanced.meaning: The travellers were forced into a long wait because of bad weather.
Read Aloud|Advanced.sentence: اضطُرَّ المُسافِرونَ إلى الانتِظارِ طَويلًا بِسَبَبِ سوءِ الأحوالِ الجَوِّيَّةِ.

Read Aloud|Advanced.meaning: His remarks centred on the need to balance ambition against the resources actually available.
Read Aloud|Advanced.sentence: تَركَّزَت مُداخَلَتُهُ عَلى ضَرورَةِ التَّوازُنِ بَينَ الطُّموحِ وَالإمكاناتِ المُتاحَةِ.

Read Aloud|Advanced.meaning: The payoff of regular practice becomes obvious when you compare performance after only two weeks.
Read Aloud|Advanced.sentence: يَتَّضِحُ أثَرُ التَّدريبِ المُنتَظِمِ حينَ نُقارِنُ الأداءَ بَعدَ أُسبوعَينِ فَقَط.

Read Aloud|Advanced.meaning: The report concluded that cooperation between institutions cuts down waste considerably.
Read Aloud|Advanced.sentence: خَلَصَ التَّقريرُ إلى أنَّ التَّعاوُنَ بَينَ المُؤَسَّساتِ يُخَفِّفُ كَثيرًا مِنَ الهَدرِ.

Read Aloud|Beginner.meaning: A friendly morning greeting: good morning, how are you doing today, my friend?
Read Aloud|Beginner.sentence: صَباحُ الخَيرِ، كَيفَ حالُكَ اليَومَ يا صَديقي؟

Read Aloud|Beginner.meaning: The speaker has coffee every morning before heading off to work.
Read Aloud|Beginner.sentence: أنا أشرَبُ القَهوَةَ كُلَّ صَباحٍ قَبلَ العَمَلِ.

Read Aloud|Beginner.meaning: The house is large, and the garden in front of it is really lovely.
Read Aloud|Beginner.sentence: البَيتُ كَبيرٌ، وَالحَديقَةُ أمامَهُ جَميلَةٌ جِدًّا.

Read Aloud|Beginner.meaning: This is my new book, and it is both easy to read and helpful.
Read Aloud|Beginner.sentence: هَذا كِتابي الجَديدُ، وَهُوَ سَهلٌ وَمُفيدٌ.

Read Aloud|Beginner.meaning: Someone is looking for the key and guesses it is lying on the table.
Read Aloud|Beginner.sentence: أينَ المِفتاحُ؟ أظُنُّ أنَّهُ عَلى الطّاوِلَةِ.

Read Aloud|Beginner.meaning: We go to the market on Friday mornings.
Read Aloud|Beginner.sentence: نَحنُ نَذهَبُ إلى السّوقِ يَومَ الجُمُعَةِ صَباحًا.

Read Aloud|Beginner.meaning: The weather today is a little cold, but still pleasant.
Read Aloud|Beginner.sentence: الطَّقسُ اليَومَ بارِدٌ قَليلًا، لَكِنَّهُ جَميلٌ.

Read Aloud|Beginner.meaning: The speaker enjoys mint tea but does not want it very sweet.
Read Aloud|Beginner.sentence: أُحِبُّ الشّايَ بِالنَّعناعِ، وَلا أُحِبُّ السُّكَّرَ الكَثيرَ.

Read Aloud|Beginner.meaning: My little sister is playing with the cat inside the room.
Read Aloud|Beginner.sentence: أختي الصَّغيرَةُ تَلعَبُ مَعَ القِطَّةِ في الغُرفَةِ.

Read Aloud|Beginner.meaning: A polite request: please hand me a glass of cold water.
Read Aloud|Beginner.sentence: مِن فَضلِكَ، أعطِني كوبَ ماءٍ باردٍ.

Read Aloud|Beginner.meaning: The speaker is a student who studies Arabic every single day.
Read Aloud|Beginner.sentence: أنا طالِبٌ، وَأدرُسُ اللُّغَةَ العَرَبِيَّةَ كُلَّ يَومٍ.

Read Aloud|Beginner.meaning: Lunch is ready, so come over and sit down with us.
Read Aloud|Beginner.sentence: الغَداءُ جاهِزٌ الآنَ، تَعالَ وَاجلِس مَعَنا.

Read Aloud|Beginner.meaning: A warm thank you to someone who gave a lot of help today.
Read Aloud|Beginner.sentence: شُكرًا جَزيلًا لَكَ، لَقَد ساعَدتَني كَثيرًا اليَومَ.

Read Aloud|Beginner.meaning: Asking for directions: do you know how to get to the nearby station?
Read Aloud|Beginner.sentence: هَل تَعرِفُ الطَّريقَ إلى المَحَطَّةِ القَريبَةِ مِن هُنا؟

Read Aloud|Beginner.meaning: In the evening the speaker takes a short walk and then heads back home.
Read Aloud|Beginner.sentence: في المَساءِ، أمشي قَليلًا ثُمَّ أعودُ إلى البَيتِ.

Read Aloud|Beginner.meaning: This room is clean, and the window has been left open to let fresh air in.
Read Aloud|Beginner.sentence: هَذِهِ الغُرفَةُ نَظيفَةٌ، وَالنّافِذَةُ مَفتوحَةٌ لِلهَواءِ.

Read Aloud|Beginner.meaning: The speaker is really glad to have seen the other person today.
Read Aloud|Beginner.sentence: أنا سَعيدٌ جِدًّا لِأنَّني رَأيتُكَ اليَومَ.

Read Aloud|Beginner.meaning: The speaker has a short lesson coming up in roughly an hour.
Read Aloud|Beginner.sentence: عِندي دَرسٌ قَصيرٌ بَعدَ ساعَةٍ واحِدَةٍ تَقريبًا.

Read Aloud|Beginner.meaning: The boy reads a short story before going to sleep.
Read Aloud|Beginner.sentence: الوَلَدُ يَقرَأُ قِصَّةً قَصيرَةً قَبلَ النَّومِ.

Read Aloud|Beginner.meaning: The speaker does not understand a word and asks the other person to say it again slowly.
Read Aloud|Beginner.sentence: لا أفهَمُ هَذِهِ الكَلِمَةَ، مِن فَضلِكَ أعِدها بِبُطءٍ.

Read Aloud|Intermediate.meaning: The speaker likes getting up early because mornings feel calm and restful.
Read Aloud|Intermediate.sentence: أفَضِّلُ أن أستَيقِظَ مُبَكِّرًا لِأنَّ الصَّباحَ هادِئٌ وَمُريحٌ.

Read Aloud|Intermediate.meaning: Once the workday is over, the speaker usually stops by the public library.
Read Aloud|Intermediate.sentence: بَعدَ انتِهاءِ الدَّوامِ، عادَةً ما أمُرُّ عَلى المَكتَبَةِ العامَّةِ.

Read Aloud|Intermediate.meaning: The speaker slept badly and is feeling tired this morning as a result.
Read Aloud|Intermediate.sentence: لَم أستَطِع النَّومَ جَيِّدًا، لِذَلِكَ أشعُرُ بِالتَّعَبِ هَذا الصَّباحَ.

Read Aloud|Intermediate.meaning: If the train runs late, they will take a taxi to the hotel instead.
Read Aloud|Intermediate.sentence: إذا تَأخَّرَ القِطارُ، سَنَأخُذُ سَيّارَةَ أُجرَةٍ إلى الفُندُقِ.

Read Aloud|Intermediate.meaning: The speaker believes the meeting will start at around half past ten.
Read Aloud|Intermediate.sentence: أعتَقِدُ أنَّ الاجتِماعَ سَيَبدَأُ في العاشِرَةِ وَالنِّصفِ تَقريبًا.

Read Aloud|Intermediate.meaning: Picking up a new language takes patience and steady practice every day.
Read Aloud|Intermediate.sentence: تَعَلُّمُ لُغَةٍ جَديدَةٍ يَحتاجُ إلى صَبرٍ وَتَدريبٍ يَومِيٍّ مُستَمِرٍّ.

Read Aloud|Intermediate.meaning: The food tasted great, but the restaurant was packed and noisy.
Read Aloud|Intermediate.sentence: كانَ الطَّعامُ لَذيذًا، لَكِنَّ المَطعَمَ كانَ مُزدَحِمًا وَصاخِبًا.

Read Aloud|Intermediate.meaning: The speaker promises to send the full details as soon as they are back at the office.
Read Aloud|Intermediate.sentence: سَأُرسِلُ لَكَ التَّفاصيلَ الكامِلَةَ حالَما أعودُ إلى المَكتَبِ.

Read Aloud|Intermediate.meaning: It would be wiser to put the trip off until the weather gets better.
Read Aloud|Intermediate.sentence: مِنَ الأفضَلِ أن نُؤَجِّلَ الرِّحلَةَ حَتّى يَتَحَسَّنَ الطَّقسُ.

Read Aloud|Intermediate.meaning: The speaker noticed the street became much quieter once the shops closed.
Read Aloud|Intermediate.sentence: لاحَظتُ أنَّ الشّارِعَ أصبَحَ أهدَأَ بَعدَ إغلاقِ المَحَلّاتِ.

Read Aloud|Intermediate.meaning: A polite request to go over the idea one more time, slowly.
Read Aloud|Intermediate.sentence: هَل يُمكِنُكَ أن تَشرَحَ لي الفِكرَةَ مَرَّةً أُخرى بِبُطءٍ؟

Read Aloud|Intermediate.meaning: They spent the holiday at the beach and enjoyed the fresh air and the water.
Read Aloud|Intermediate.sentence: قَضَينا العُطلَةَ عَلى الشّاطِئِ، وَاستَمتَعنا بِالهَواءِ وَالماءِ.

Read Aloud|Intermediate.meaning: The speaker is trying to cut back on drinking coffee later in the day.
Read Aloud|Intermediate.sentence: أحاوِلُ أن أُقَلِّلَ مِن شُربِ القَهوَةِ في ساعاتِ المَساءِ.

Read Aloud|Intermediate.meaning: By the time the speaker reached the station, the train had already gone.
Read Aloud|Intermediate.sentence: عِندَما وَصَلتُ إلى المَحَطَّةِ، كانَ القِطارُ قَد غادَرَ بِالفِعلِ.

Read Aloud|Intermediate.meaning: Doctors say that a daily walk is good for both your health and your mood.
Read Aloud|Intermediate.sentence: يَقولُ الأطِبّاءُ إنَّ المَشيَ اليَومِيَّ يُحَسِّنُ الصِّحَّةَ وَالمِزاجَ.

Read Aloud|Intermediate.meaning: The speaker apologises for intruding but needs a bit of help.
Read Aloud|Intermediate.sentence: لا أُريدُ أن أُزعِجَكَ، لَكِنَّني بِحاجَةٍ إلى مُساعَدَتِكَ قَليلًا.

Read Aloud|Intermediate.meaning: The more the speaker reads, the more new vocabulary they come to know.
Read Aloud|Intermediate.sentence: كُلَّما قَرَأتُ أكثَرَ، اتَّسَعَت مَعرِفَتي بِالكَلِماتِ الجَديدَةِ.

Read Aloud|Intermediate.meaning: The speaker made a promise to themselves to finish this project before the month ends.
Read Aloud|Intermediate.sentence: وَعَدتُ نَفسي بِأن أُنهِيَ هَذا المَشروعَ قَبلَ نِهايَةِ الشَّهرِ.

Read Aloud|Intermediate.meaning: Tired as they were, the speaker felt very satisfied with how it turned out.
Read Aloud|Intermediate.sentence: عَلى الرَّغمِ مِنَ التَّعَبِ، شَعَرتُ بِرِضًا كَبيرٍ عَنِ النَّتيجَةِ.

Read Aloud|Intermediate.meaning: It matters that we listen properly instead of rushing to answer.
Read Aloud|Intermediate.sentence: مِنَ المُهِمِّ أن نَستَمِعَ جَيِّدًا قَبلَ أن نُجيبَ بِسُرعَةٍ.

Speak Sentences|Advanced.meaning: There is no denying that advances in technology have completely changed the way people communicate.
Speak Sentences|Advanced.sentence: لا يمكن إنكار أن التطور التكنولوجي غير أساليب التواصل بين الناس جذريا.

Speak Sentences|Advanced.meaning: The report took two weeks to prepare because it needed careful checking of many sources that contradicted each other.
Speak Sentences|Advanced.sentence: استغرق إعداد التقرير أسبوعين لأنه تطلب مراجعة دقيقة لمصادر متعددة ومتضاربة.

Speak Sentences|Advanced.meaning: Researchers expect that global warming will affect farm crops in the years ahead.
Speak Sentences|Advanced.sentence: يفترض الباحثون أن ظاهرة الاحتباس الحراري ستؤثر على المحاصيل الزراعية مستقبلا.

Speak Sentences|Advanced.meaning: I got fed up with all the noise, so I decided to spend my holiday somewhere quiet.
Speak Sentences|Advanced.sentence: ضاق صدري من كثرة الضجيج فقررت أن أقضي عطلتي في مكان هادئ.

Speak Sentences|Advanced.meaning: Despite the difficult economy, the company still managed to make astonishing profits.
Speak Sentences|Advanced.sentence: رغم الصعوبات الاقتصادية إلا أن الشركة تمكنت من تحقيق أرباح مذهلة.

Speak Sentences|Advanced.meaning: Admitting you were wrong is a virtue only truly big-hearted people can manage.
Speak Sentences|Advanced.sentence: إن الاعتراف بالخطأ فضيلة لا يقدر عليها إلا أصحاب النفوس الكبيرة.

Speak Sentences|Advanced.meaning: Mastering a language takes daily practice, long-term persistence and patience with your own mistakes.
Speak Sentences|Advanced.sentence: تحتاج إتقان اللغة إلى ممارسة يومية ومثابرة طويلة وصبر على الأخطاء.

Speak Sentences|Advanced.meaning: The minister's speech set off a wide debate among specialists in higher education.
Speak Sentences|Advanced.sentence: أثار خطاب الوزير جدلا واسعا بين المختصين في مجال التعليم العالي.

Speak Sentences|Advanced.meaning: I have noticed that most students prefer studying together to revising alone in silence.
Speak Sentences|Advanced.sentence: لاحظت أن معظم الطلاب يفضلون الدراسة الجماعية على المراجعة الفردية الصامتة.

Speak Sentences|Advanced.meaning: The more experience a person gains, the clearer the limits of their knowledge become, and the humbler they grow before the truth.
Speak Sentences|Advanced.sentence: كلما ازدادت خبرة الإنسان اتضحت له حدود معرفته وتواضع أمام الحقيقة.

Speak Sentences|Advanced.meaning: The authorities made a point of putting preventive measures in place before the infection could spread through the population.
Speak Sentences|Advanced.sentence: حرصت الجهات المختصة على تطبيق الإجراءات الوقائية قبل انتشار العدوى بين السكان.

Speak Sentences|Advanced.meaning: It never once crossed my mind that this decision would change the whole course of my career.
Speak Sentences|Advanced.sentence: لم يخطر ببالي قط أن هذا القرار سيغير مسار حياتي المهنية.

Speak Sentences|Advanced.meaning: Meeting these challenges calls for strategic planning and close cooperation across the different sectors.
Speak Sentences|Advanced.sentence: تتطلب مواجهة هذه التحديات تخطيطا استراتيجيا وتعاونا وثيقا بين مختلف القطاعات.

Speak Sentences|Advanced.meaning: As the saying goes, birds of a feather flock together, and that holds true most of the time.
Speak Sentences|Advanced.sentence: يقول المثل إن الطيور على أشكالها تقع وهذا صحيح في أغلب الأحيان.

Speak Sentences|Advanced.meaning: I had to postpone my doctor's appointment because work made it impossible for me to go.
Speak Sentences|Advanced.sentence: اضطررت إلى تأجيل موعد الطبيب لأن ظروف العمل لم تسمح بالحضور.

Speak Sentences|Advanced.meaning: I suspect the vague wording of the contract will cause plenty of disputes between the two sides.
Speak Sentences|Advanced.sentence: أظن أن الغموض في صياغة العقد سيسبب خلافات كثيرة بين الطرفين.

Speak Sentences|Advanced.meaning: I listened to a fascinating lecture about how deep reading affects concentration and memory.
Speak Sentences|Advanced.sentence: استمعت إلى محاضرة شيقة تناولت تأثير القراءة العميقة على التركيز والذاكرة.

Speak Sentences|Advanced.meaning: It is essential to tell constructive criticism apart from a personal attack when we are discussing ideas.
Speak Sentences|Advanced.sentence: من الضروري أن نميز بين النقد البناء والهجوم الشخصي عند مناقشة الأفكار.

Speak Sentences|Advanced.meaning: The project went through a full review that exposed serious gaps in the proposed budget.
Speak Sentences|Advanced.sentence: خضع المشروع لمراجعة شاملة كشفت ثغرات خطيرة في الميزانية المقترحة.

Speak Sentences|Advanced.meaning: Mental health remains a sensitive subject that many people avoid speaking about with complete honesty.
Speak Sentences|Advanced.sentence: تظل الصحة النفسية موضوعا حساسا يتجنب كثيرون الحديث عنه بصراحة تامة.

Speak Sentences|Beginner.meaning: I drink tea in the morning every day.
Speak Sentences|Beginner.sentence: أنا أشرب الشاي في الصباح كل يوم.

Speak Sentences|Beginner.meaning: This book is new and really nice.
Speak Sentences|Beginner.sentence: هذا الكتاب جديد وجميل جدا.

Speak Sentences|Beginner.meaning: Mum, where is the key, please?
Speak Sentences|Beginner.sentence: أين المفتاح يا أمي من فضلك؟

Speak Sentences|Beginner.meaning: We go to school early in the morning.
Speak Sentences|Beginner.sentence: نحن نذهب إلى المدرسة في الصباح الباكر.

Speak Sentences|Beginner.meaning: The house is big, and the garden in front of it is small.
Speak Sentences|Beginner.sentence: البيت كبير والحديقة أمامه صغيرة.

Speak Sentences|Beginner.meaning: I would like a glass of cold water, please.
Speak Sentences|Beginner.sentence: أريد كوب ماء بارد من فضلك.

Speak Sentences|Beginner.meaning: The weather today is lovely and very pleasant.
Speak Sentences|Beginner.sentence: الطقس اليوم جميل ولطيف جدا.

Speak Sentences|Beginner.meaning: I am very happy today because of this news.
Speak Sentences|Beginner.sentence: أنا سعيد جدا اليوم بهذا الخبر.

Speak Sentences|Beginner.meaning: Do you like coffee, or would you rather have tea?
Speak Sentences|Beginner.sentence: هل تحب القهوة أم تفضل الشاي؟

Speak Sentences|Beginner.meaning: My little sister is playing in the garden right now.
Speak Sentences|Beginner.sentence: أختي الصغيرة تلعب في الحديقة الآن.

Speak Sentences|Beginner.meaning: We eat bread and cheese for breakfast.
Speak Sentences|Beginner.sentence: نأكل الخبز والجبن في وجبة الفطور.

Speak Sentences|Beginner.meaning: The market is close to our house and very cheap.
Speak Sentences|Beginner.sentence: السوق قريب من بيتنا ورخيص جدا.

Speak Sentences|Beginner.meaning: I study Arabic every evening.
Speak Sentences|Beginner.sentence: أنا أدرس اللغة العربية كل مساء.

Speak Sentences|Beginner.meaning: This room is clean, and the window is open at the moment.
Speak Sentences|Beginner.sentence: هذه الغرفة نظيفة والنافذة مفتوحة الآن.

Speak Sentences|Beginner.meaning: My father has worked at the hospital for many years.
Speak Sentences|Beginner.sentence: أبي يعمل في المستشفى منذ سنوات طويلة.

Speak Sentences|Beginner.meaning: The little cat is sleeping under the chair.
Speak Sentences|Beginner.sentence: القطة الصغيرة تنام تحت الكرسي.

Speak Sentences|Beginner.meaning: Please pass me the salt and the pepper.
Speak Sentences|Beginner.sentence: من فضلك أعطني الملح والفلفل.

Speak Sentences|Beginner.meaning: The bus will get to the station shortly.
Speak Sentences|Beginner.sentence: الحافلة تصل بعد قليل إلى المحطة.

Speak Sentences|Beginner.meaning: I am hungry and I want to eat something now.
Speak Sentences|Beginner.sentence: أنا جائع وأريد أن آكل شيئا الآن.

Speak Sentences|Beginner.meaning: My friend lives near my new house.
Speak Sentences|Beginner.sentence: صديقي يسكن قريبا من بيتي الجديد.

Speak Sentences|Intermediate.meaning: I think the weather will get much better by the end of this week.
Speak Sentences|Intermediate.sentence: أعتقد أن الطقس سيتحسن كثيرا في نهاية هذا الأسبوع.

Speak Sentences|Intermediate.meaning: I tried to call you yesterday, but your phone was switched off.
Speak Sentences|Intermediate.sentence: حاولت أن أتصل بك أمس لكن هاتفك كان مغلقا.

Speak Sentences|Intermediate.meaning: I could not get to sleep early because the neighbours were talking loudly.
Speak Sentences|Intermediate.sentence: لم أستطع النوم مبكرا لأن الجيران كانوا يتحدثون بصوت عال.

Speak Sentences|Intermediate.meaning: I will book a table at the restaurant before the place fills up with customers.
Speak Sentences|Intermediate.sentence: سأحجز طاولة في المطعم قبل أن يمتلئ المكان بالزبائن.

Speak Sentences|Intermediate.meaning: Every time I read a new book, I feel I have learned something useful.
Speak Sentences|Intermediate.sentence: كلما قرأت كتابا جديدا شعرت أنني تعلمت شيئا مفيدا.

Speak Sentences|Intermediate.meaning: I would rather we took the train instead of the car, to save time.
Speak Sentences|Intermediate.sentence: أفضل أن نأخذ القطار بدلا من السيارة لتوفير الوقت.

Speak Sentences|Intermediate.meaning: The doctor told me to drink plenty of water and stay away from fizzy drinks.
Speak Sentences|Intermediate.sentence: أخبرني الطبيب أن أشرب الماء كثيرا وأتجنب المشروبات الغازية.

Speak Sentences|Intermediate.meaning: Even though the journey is long, the view is worth the effort.
Speak Sentences|Intermediate.sentence: رغم أن الطريق طويل إلا أن المنظر يستحق التعب.

Speak Sentences|Intermediate.meaning: I left my wallet at home, so I rushed back for it before the meeting.
Speak Sentences|Intermediate.sentence: نسيت محفظتي في البيت لذلك عدت مسرعا قبل الاجتماع.

Speak Sentences|Intermediate.meaning: I have been working at this company for about three years.
Speak Sentences|Intermediate.sentence: أعمل في هذه الشركة منذ ثلاث سنوات تقريبا.

Speak Sentences|Intermediate.meaning: Could you explain this idea to me one more time?
Speak Sentences|Intermediate.sentence: هل يمكنك أن تشرح لي هذه الفكرة مرة أخرى؟

Speak Sentences|Intermediate.meaning: I bought my sister a small gift to celebrate her passing the exam.
Speak Sentences|Intermediate.sentence: اشتريت هدية بسيطة لأختي بمناسبة نجاحها في الامتحان.

Speak Sentences|Intermediate.meaning: I was planning to go out, but it suddenly started pouring with rain.
Speak Sentences|Intermediate.sentence: كنت أنوي الخروج لكن المطر بدأ ينزل بغزارة فجأة.

Speak Sentences|Intermediate.meaning: I have learned that patience helps me a great deal in life's hard moments.
Speak Sentences|Intermediate.sentence: تعلمت أن الصبر يساعدني كثيرا في مواقف الحياة الصعبة.

Speak Sentences|Intermediate.meaning: I sent the message in the morning and still have not had a reply.
Speak Sentences|Intermediate.sentence: أرسلت الرسالة صباحا ولم يصلني الرد حتى هذه اللحظة.

Speak Sentences|Intermediate.meaning: I like walking in the park after dinner to help my food go down.
Speak Sentences|Intermediate.sentence: أحب أن أمشي في الحديقة بعد العشاء لأهضم الطعام.

Speak Sentences|Intermediate.meaning: If I were you, I would ask a colleague who knows the subject for help.
Speak Sentences|Intermediate.sentence: لو كنت مكانك لطلبت المساعدة من زميل يعرف الموضوع.

Speak Sentences|Intermediate.meaning: The flight schedule changed, so we had to put the trip off by a whole week.
Speak Sentences|Intermediate.sentence: تغير جدول الرحلات فاضطررنا إلى تأجيل السفر أسبوعا كاملا.

Speak Sentences|Intermediate.meaning: I cannot remember the name of the street, but I know how to get there.
Speak Sentences|Intermediate.sentence: لا أستطيع تذكر اسم الشارع لكنني أعرف طريق الوصول.

Speak Sentences|Intermediate.meaning: We ought to agree on a time that suits everyone before the day is over.
Speak Sentences|Intermediate.sentence: ينبغي أن نتفق على موعد يناسب الجميع قبل نهاية اليوم.
